fields.description:
We want to be able to offer a returning customer a follow-on booking once a rental has been completed. The customer gets a note in their account saying they can book the same item again for a further rental window without entering their details a second time.

The deposit should not be taken a second time when the previous rental was completed with no damage report. The handover record from the previous rental should be attached to the follow-on booking, so the depot can see what condition the item was in.

The team should also be able to see in the dashboard which follow-on bookings came out of a reactivation, and to switch reactivation off per depot.
